reference.title: Carbamazepine markedly reduces serum concentrations of simvastatin and simvastatin acid.
reference.abstract: Carbamazepine greatly reduces the serum concentrations of simvastatin and simvastatin acid, probably by inducing their metabolism. Concomitant administration of carbamazepine and simvastatin should be avoided or the dose of simvastatin should be considerably increased.
